data.title: Elva
data.about:
Discover the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility at Elva, The Valley, nestled in serene, picturesque surroundings, creating a haven away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It offers exquisitely designed 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses with a flexible payment plan. With world-class amenities thoughtfully integrated into its master plan, Elva by Emaar ensures that every aspect of your lifestyle is catered to, from leisure and wellness to family-friendly facilities. This is your opportunity to embrace an elevated standard of living where sophistication meets ultimate comfort.

Crafted by Emaar, a trusted name in real estate, Elva, The Valley, offers an easy payment plan, making your dream home more accessible than ever. With its modern architecture, lush landscapes, and a community-centered approach, this project promises an unparalleled living experience. Stay tuned for the official launch and be among the first to secure your place in this exceptional development. Your dream home awaits at Elva, The Valley—coming soon!

characteristics_module.title: Elva at The Valley: Nestled in a Tranquil, Scenic Environment
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Large-Sized Townhouses: Spacious 3 and 4-bedroom layouts designed to maximize comfort and functionality for families.
  • World-Class Amenities: Enjoy access to premium facilities including parks, sports courts, swimming pools, and community spaces.
  • Crafted by Emaar: Developed by one of the most trusted names in real estate, ensuring quality and reliability.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Easy and convenient payment options to make owning your dream home more achievable.
  • Community-Centered Design: A master-planned community focused on fostering a sense of belonging and a vibrant lifestyle.
  • Prime Location: Strategically located within The Valley, offering easy access to key landmarks and city hubs.

location_tile.title: The Valley: Where Families Thrive and Dreams Come Alive
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Elva at The Valley is a premium addition to Emaar's master-planned community, located along Dubai-Al Ain Road. Nestled in a serene and picturesque environment, The Valley offers a perfect balance between modern living and natural tranquility. This vibrant community is thoughtfully designed with lush green landscapes, open spaces, and world-class amenities, making it an ideal destination for families.

  • Global Village: 20 minutes
  • IMG Worlds of Adventure: 25 minutes
  • Dubai Outlet Mall: 10 minutes
  • Dubai Silicon Oasis: 20 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai: 25 minutes
